title: relay queue done rejects real tests in two common shapes
what: relay queue done accepts the test name in every shape the cycle and pytest print (file::Class.name, file::Class::name, file::name) in both the -C and --fixed-by forms, and --fixed-by counts a test file absent at the parent as failing there (the fix added the case).
why: 29 Oct: closing landed items took the front 6 extra commands and a runner ran out of turns. Two shapes fail: (1) the cycle passes --test file::Class.name to the -C form, which only accepts file::name (refused "does not hold a test named KitName.test_old_core_folder_is_not_exempt", accepted as file::test_old_core_folder_is_not_exempt); (2) --fixed-by refuses a fix whose test file the fix itself added ("cannot tell whether ... fails at bdd0f4c2e518 ... it did not run to a pass or a fail"), so queue-time-estimates-are-guesses-with-no-model-b stays taken after its branch landed.
failing_case: From /Users/amidman/relay on 29 Oct: `bin/relay queue done a-test-still-exempts-the-old-plugins-core-bin-ki -C <wt> --test tests/test_hook_kit_name.py::KitName.test_old_core_folder_is_not_exempt` refused; `bin/relay queue done queue-time-estimates-are-guesses-with-no-model-b --fixed-by 4a3b4013 --test tests/test_queue_estimate.py::Estimate::test_median_fixed_plus_median_build` refused (file added by 4a3b4013).
pass_cases: The -C form closes with file::Class.name and file::Class::name as with file::name
--fixed-by closes when the test file does not exist at the commit's parent and the test passes at the commit
--fixed-by still refuses a test that passes at the parent
